## Motivation

When a streaming request is aborted with an explicit error `status_code` **before the first chunk is emitted** — e.g. an admission-time rejection like `"The request queue is full."` once `--max-running-requests` / `--max-queued-requests` is exceeded — the OpenAI serving layer emits the error as an in-band SSE chunk under an **already-committed HTTP 200**. Clients and reverse proxies that key on the HTTP status code see a `200` and cannot tell the request was actually rejected, so they cannot retry or route on a real `503`.

The kick-start `generator.__anext__()` in `_handle_streaming_request` already exists precisely to surface pre-200 validation failures as real HTTP errors, but it only catches `ValueError`. An abort delivered via a `finish_reason` carrying a `status_code` is **yielded as a chunk** rather than raised, so it slips past that guard and the 200 is committed.

## Modifications

- Add `StreamingAbortBeforeFirstChunk` in `serving_base.py`. It carries `message` / `err_type` / `status_code` and is intentionally **not** a `ValueError` subclass (which is already mapped to a default 400), so the real status code is preserved.
- In the chat and completions streaming generators, when an abort with an `HTTPStatus` `status_code` arrives while `stream_started is False`, **raise** `StreamingAbortBeforeFirstChunk` instead of yielding the SSE error chunk.
- `_handle_streaming_request` (chat & completions) catches it from the kick-start `__anext__()` and returns a real `create_error_response(message, err_type, status_code)` whose HTTP status matches the body.
- Behavior **after** streaming has started is unchanged: the 200 status line is already on the wire, so the existing in-band SSE error-chunk path is kept. Fully backwards compatible.

Files: `serving_base.py`, `serving_chat.py`, `serving_completions.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — serving/transport-layer only; no change to model forward or kernels.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — only affects the error path for requests rejected before the first token; no impact on the normal generation hot path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). <!-- happy to add a focused async test for the pre-stream abort path if maintainers prefer -->
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (N/A for this change).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -23,6 +23,30 @@
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
+class StreamingAbortBeforeFirstChunk(Exception):
+    """Raised inside a streaming generator when the request is aborted with an
+    explicit error ``status_code`` BEFORE any chunk has been emitted (e.g. an
+    admission-time rejection such as "The request queue is full.").
+
+    At that point the HTTP 200 status line has not been committed yet, so the
+    handler can catch this and return a real HTTP error response whose status
+    code matches the error body -- instead of streaming the error inside an SSE
+    body under a 200 status. Once streaming has started the 200 is already on
+    the wire and an in-band SSE error chunk is the only option, so this is NOT
+    raised in that case.
+
+    Deliberately not a subclass of ``ValueError``: ``ValueError`` is already
+    caught and mapped to a default 400, which would discard the real status
+    code carried here.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, err_type: str, status_code: int):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message = message
+        self.err_type = err_type
+        self.status_code = status_code
+
+
 # Base class for specific endpoint handlers
 class OpenAIServingBase(ABC):
     """Abstract base class for OpenAI endpoint handlers"""

@@ -75,7 +75,10 @@ class ThinkingMode(str, Enum):
     ToolChoice,
     TopLogprob,
 )
-from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_base import OpenAIServingBase
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_base import (
+    OpenAIServingBase,
+    StreamingAbortBeforeFirstChunk,
+)
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.sse_utils import build_sse_content
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.usage_processor import UsageProcessor
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.utils import (
@@ -1937,6 +1940,10 @@ async def _handle_streaming_request(
             first_chunk = await generator.__anext__()
         except ValueError as e:
             return self.create_error_response(str(e))
+        except StreamingAbortBeforeFirstChunk as e:
+            # Abort decided before HTTP 200 was committed (e.g. queue full):
+            # return a real HTTP error so the status code matches the body.
+            return self.create_error_response(e.message, e.err_type, e.status_code)
 
         async def prepend_first_chunk():
             yield first_chunk
@@ -2077,8 +2084,21 @@ async def _generate_chat_stream(
